speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what is the information on job, business or income which HDB will require from a person who is making a housing loan application and what is the time period required for such information; and (b) whether there is any distinction between the information required for (i) employed persons and (ii) self-employed persons.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: HDB will reach out to applicants if further supporting documents are needed.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: Does and will the HDB give different considerations in their assessment of the income of the self-employed to take into account that the business owner or the self-employed may not pay themselves regularly?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: For example, would the HDB take into account the annual income as declared to the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS)?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: Number two, where the business income may vary.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: For example, even in a short period of time where a self-employed's business income trajectory increases considerably, can the HDB exercise some flexibility to look at the uptrend of the income at the time of the application?
